item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena is sitting inside a moving train. Her brother Rohan is standing on the platform as the train passes by.
Which statement about Meena's state of motion is correct?

options.A: Meena is at rest with respect to the train seat, but in motion with respect to Rohan on the platform.
options.B: Meena is at rest with respect to everything, because she is sitting down and not moving her body.
options.C: Meena is in motion with respect to everything, because the train is moving.
options.D: Meena is in motion with respect to the train seat, but at rest with respect to Rohan on the platform.
